articles.title: Comparison of approaches for incorporating depredation on fisheries catches into Ecopath
articles.authors: Lyndsay Clavareau; Martin P. Marzloff; Verena M. Trenkel; Catherine M. Bulman; Sophie Gourguet; Bertrand Le Gallic; Pierre-Yves Hernvann; Clara Péron; Nicolas Gasco; Johanna Faure; Paul Tixier
articles.loadability_evidence: Native EwE model not verified. Article explicitly states underlying data cannot be shared publicly due to confidentiality agreements. 46-page review-manuscript PDF located; parameter completeness still requires extraction.
articles.documentation_evidence: Case study specifies 59 groups: 38 area-specific and 21 shared between Crozet and Kerguelen; supplementary parameterization and fishery tables referenced.
articles.notes: Combined spatial structure should not be mistaken for two independent complete EEZ models. Archimer labels 78763 main (15p), 78764 supplementary (46p). File 78764.pdf is a 46-page review manuscript of the same article, not a separate verified supplement.

articles.title: Time-Dynamic Food Web Modeling to Explore Environmental Drivers of Ecosystem Change on the Kerguelen Plateau
articles.authors: Roshni C. Subramaniam; Jessica Melbourne-Thomas; Stuart P. Corney; Karen Alexander; Clara Péron; Philippe Ziegler; Kerrie M. Swadling
articles.model_years: Mean-state Ecopath late 1980s–2018; Ecosim variants 1986–2018 and 2006–2018
articles.loadability_evidence: No native model file verified. Authors explicitly withhold CPUE, catch and model-estimated biomass time series under confidentiality agreements; full dynamic reproduction is not established.
articles.documentation_evidence: Methods identify 28 groups, balanced parameters Tables A1–A2 and time-series descriptions Table A3 in supplemental appendix. Figure 1 gives actual model rectangle.
articles.notes: Baseline companion is Subramaniam et al. 2020, Exploring ecosystem structure and function of the northern Kerguelen Plateau using a mass-balanced food web model, doi:10.1016/j.dsr2.2020.104787. Supplement link is publisher landing section, not confirmed binary.
